name: mcon_get_contact
description: Get one contact in full by `slug` (from mcon_list_contacts / mcon_search). Returns every field: display_name, given_name, family_name, nickname, organization, job_title, birth_month, birth_day, birth_year, notes (markdown), tags[], and the repeatable arrays phones/emails/urls ([{label,value}]) and addresses ([{label,street,city,region,postal,country}]), plus version and photo_updated_at. Read this before mcon_update_contact so you can resend whole arrays correctly.
